eyebrow: A Colorado State University student club
tagline: Small choices. Stronger community. Greener campus.
intro: We bring Rams together to care for CSU and Fort Collins through community cleanups, environmental action, and practical sustainability education.
mission: Our goal is to give students a direct way to contribute to the communities of Colorado State and Fort Collins by cleaning our surroundings, supporting sustainability efforts, and taking part in environmental activism.

home.meetingsIntro: We hold one formal planning meeting each month and aim for two or three activities or meetups. No sustainability experience required.
home.instagramEmpty: Our Instagram is live. Photos are coming soon.

leadership.title: Rams with some plans.
leadership.intro: Meet the students helping Rams Go Green turn good ideas into action.

pageText.footerText: A student-led club at Colorado State University.

activities.title: Community cleanups
activities.description: Pick up litter after events, join larger cleanup days, and help leave campus and Fort Collins better than we found them.

activities.title: Education & action
activities.description: Build awareness through flyers, conversations, and hands-on activities that make environmentalism approachable.

activities.title: Local partnerships
activities.description: Work with the Univirsite and local government to support sustainability efforts led by CSU, Fort Collins, and Northern Colorado.

officers.name: Jack
officers.bio: Leads meetings, coordinates activities, delegates responsibilities, and keeps the club aligned with CSU requirements and its constitution.

officers.name: Sadie
officers.bio: Also serves as treasurer. Supports club planning, coordinates with CSU and the city, maintains financial records and reports, and helps document meetings.
